notes.title: Playtest Update 0.1.3: Brazilian Portuguese & Japanese Added!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Just dropped update 0.1.3 for the Playtest!

This version includes:
[list]
[*] Some visual improvements.
[*] Localization for Brazilian Portuguese and Japanese!
[/list]
Yep, you can now play the Playtest in these languages! I was able to translate these myself and wanted to get them out there for you. I plan to add professional translations for more languages later, closer to release.

If you're in the Playtest, you'll get the update automatically. Want to join? Head to the store page and click "Request Access."

[h3]Got feedback?[/h3]
Especially on the new languages! Let me know what you find – typos, weird phrasing, anything at all helps. You can hit me up in the discussions here on Steam or use the "Feedback" button right there in the game!

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Playtest Now Live! Try Glitch Gears and Share Your Feedback
notes.content:
[b]The wait is over—Glitch Gears Playtest is now live![/b]

I’m excited to share this demo with you and get your thoughts on the gameplay. In this version, everything is unlocked to make testing easy—no progression or limits, just pure, unfiltered fun!

My focus for this Playtest is on:
[list]
[*]     Gameplay Feel: How smooth and responsive are the controls?
[*]     Core Mechanics: Are the driving and dodging mechanics enjoyable and engaging?
[/list]

I value your feedback! Use the Feedback button in-game to let me know what you think—your ideas will directly help me shape the final version of the game.

Thank you for joining me on this journey! Let’s make Glitch Gears the best it can be.

Dive into the Playtest today and share your thoughts!
